title: Manual Cleave and Elution with Off-Deck Vacuum
author: Opentrons
materials: Download your protocol and unzip if needed.

steps.title: Enter protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Input the desired number of rows and columns for each 96‑well plate (up to four plates) in the parameter fields provided above.

steps.title: Download and unzip protocol
steps.instruction: Download the protocol package and unzip it if it is compressed.

steps.title: Upload custom labware to OT App
steps.instruction: In the OT App, go to More → Custom Labware → Add Labware and select the required .json labware files, if any, to upload them.

steps.title: Upload protocol file to OT App
steps.instruction: In the OT App’s Protocol tab, upload the protocol file with a .py extension.

steps.title: Set up deck according to map
steps.instruction: Arrange the deck hardware exactly as shown in the provided deck map.

steps.title: Calibrate labware, tiprack, and pipette
steps.instruction: Use the OT App to calibrate all labware, tip racks, and the pipette; consult the app’s calibration support articles if needed.

steps.title: Start the run
steps.instruction: Press Run in the OT App to execute the protocol.
